name: Member-owned public edge and home-cluster tunnel world
target: Exercise a zero-rail blank-VM BYOC control plane: owner DNS delegation, DNS-01 certificate readiness, member-owned reverse-proxy edge, and WireGuard path to a home WSL/Linux k3d endpoint.
inputs: blank VM image digest and member public address
registrar and VM authoritative nameserver sets
SSH reachability, DNS-01 publication, TLS readiness, and home tunnel reachability
observations: DNS delegation and hostname ownership are checked before route readiness
certificate or tunnel failure leaves no public route
ready traffic targets the member VM and then the home WireGuard endpoint
the simulated flow makes no managed Elanous DNS, Elanous relay, or external provider calls
the model does not execute installation commands or contact real DNS, ACME, WireGuard, or k3s services
